title: Lyse DS Machine Manifest
description: The DS Machine Manifest (schemaVersion 1): a stable, versioned, graph-derived contract describing a design system for machine consumers (agents, MCP clients, CI). Mirrors DsManifest in packages/core/src/manifest/types.ts. Built without running an audit — never affects the Health Score. Versioning policy in docs/architecture/manifest.md.

tokenSetHash.description: Opaque content hash covering the token set only (id + axis + value). Stable across component-only or usage-only changes — see docs/architecture/manifest.md.

axis.description: Token axis. Open value space — currently known values: colors, spacing, typography, radii, shadows, motion, breakpoints, zIndex, opacity, borderWidth. A future release may add a new axis without bumping schemaVersion (docs/architecture/manifest.md §4).

source.description: Where this token was declared. Open value space — currently known values: tailwind-v3, tailwind-v4, dtcg, css-custom-property, scss-variable, style-dictionary, tokens-studio, figma-variables, external-package. A future release may add a new source without bumping schemaVersion (docs/architecture/manifest.md §4).

detection.description: How Lyse identified the component. Open value space — currently known values: module-config, convention, story-backref, ds-self. A future release may add a new detection method without bumping schemaVersion (docs/architecture/manifest.md §4).

zones.description: Per-zone-kind file counts. These 7 kinds are always present, even at 0 — an absent key would be ambiguous with a genuine zero. Open value space: a future release may add a new zone-kind key without bumping schemaVersion (docs/architecture/manifest.md §4) — any additional key must still be a non-negative integer.

usage.description: Aggregated by kind (files touched + total count) — never a per-file edge list.

kind.description: Usage edge kind. Open value space — currently the only known value is imports-ds-module. A future release may add a new kind without bumping schemaVersion (docs/architecture/manifest.md §4).

extraction.description: Always present. A degraded/failed extractor with its remediation is how a consumer knows the surface is thin, instead of mistaking an empty list for 'no tokens'.

axis.description: Same open token-axis value space as tokens[].axis (docs/architecture/manifest.md §4).

items.description: Same open token-source value space as tokens[].source (docs/architecture/manifest.md §4).
